# Mork byte decoding falls back for a whole failing contiguous sequence

fixEncoding keeps escaped dollar-hex pairs literal and decodes each contiguous unescaped sequence with a per-parser fatal UTF-8 decoder. If decoding fails, the whole sequence falls back to one character per byte. This is a bounded fallback, not charset detection. The regression directly checks separate UTF-8 and single-byte values plus escaped-pair cases; it does not exhaust mixed invalid sequences. No parser run was performed.

Scope: Mork value encoding boundaries.
